name: io.github.tonyyang0504/ebay-mcp
description: eBay (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, end_listing, set_inventory, list_orders. Every tool m

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_EBAY_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Production keyset App ID (Client ID) from developer.ebay.com > Application Keys; sent with the Cert ID as HTTP Basic on the token call.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_EBAY_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: User refresh token (v^1.1#...) from a one-time authorization-code consent that granted at least sell.inventory, sell.fulfillment and sell.account (the refresh request re-asks exactly these scopes, which must be a subset of the consent); long-lived (about 18 months), revoked when the seller changes password. 2-hour user access tokens are minted from it.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_EBAY_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Currency of your listings' marketplace (e.g. USD, GBP, EUR); needed only by update_listing, since eBay prices are {value, currency} objects.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_EBAY_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = https://api.sandbox.ebay.com. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_EBAY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.
